source: Captured by scripts/generate_megahal_fixtures.rb against the vendored upstream MegaHAL gem sources (ruby_vendor/, kranzky/megahal, Unlicense) with the real `sooth` gem (2.3.2) on Ruby 4.0.6 (arm64-darwin25). Command: `ruby crates/terraphim_megahal/scripts/generate_megahal_fixtures.rb`. Canonical RNG contract: PCG32 (rand_pcg::Pcg32 + rand_core 0.10 seed_from_u64, mirrored below), rand(n) = next_u32 % n (n==0 -> 0, one draw always), Array#shuffle = descending Fisher-Yates.
